Fantasy Football Waiver Wire Targets for Week 12

  • By Kevork Mahserejian  @
  • Nov 24, 2026

NFL Week 12 is here, which means it’s time to search the fantasy football waiver wire for the best players to add before Wednesday.

The waiver wire remains a crucial resource for fantasy managers throughout the season. Whether you’re dealing with injuries, preparing for bye weeks, or simply looking to upgrade your roster, this week’s available players include several intriguing options who could fill a critical need or help fuel a playoff run.

I’ve written up some of my favorite waiver selections as we head into Week 12.

If you’re looking for more selections, you can also check out our weekly projections to see how everyone is projecting for the upcoming week.

If some of my recommended players are already taken in your league, I’d select whichever player in the projections has the highest projection for the current week at the position you want to add to your fantasy team.

Let’s dive in!
